title: French Air Puffs
description: A French dessert recipe using air, fried, starch, and delight ingredients. Crunchy outside, airy inside.

ingredients.name: Fried
ingredients.notes: Used in making the Delight component

instructions: 2. In a bowl, mix 1 cup starch and 1 cup delight.
3. Add 2 cups air to the bowl and mix until combined.
4. Add 1/4 cup fried and mix well.
5. Place mixture on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
6. Bake for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.
7. Remove from oven and let cool completely.
